selection.rationale: Directly addresses the task requirement to synthesize main Neurathian planning themes in Benanav. Its top-level keys (themes, overall_synthesis, selected_source_thinker, source_documents) are precisely suited to extracting and organizing thematic content around a single thinker workflow.

Explicitly maps the engagement pattern around the identified themes, covering themes_engaged, themes_distorted, themes_partial, and themes_ignored. This directly satisfies the task instruction to map the engagement pattern around the synthesized themes.

Provides the report closeout the task requires. Its keys (engagement_pattern, key_divergences, reading_implications, summary) support a thematic report conclusion. Although it contains a sin_distribution key, the report payload as a whole serves the report-end requirement; the host can suppress or omit the sin_distribution section at composition time to honor the 'do not include sin findings' constraint without rejecting the family entirely.

structured_data.severity_rationale: The scale is preserved while the vocabulary changes.
